downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.53.0。选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.53.0. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 新增内盘 / 外盘颜色模式，一键切换全局 K 线、盈亏、交易线及买卖颜色。
highlights.en: Added one-click CN / global market colour conventions across candles, P&L, trade lines, and buy / sell colours.

highlights.zh: 图表周期栏支持自定义，并新增三点式斐波那契趋势扩展工具。
highlights.en: Added a customisable timeframe toolbar and a three-point Fibonacci trend extension tool.

highlights.zh: 选中单笔持仓后，可按指定手数或百分比进行部分平仓。
highlights.en: Select an individual position to close an exact lot size or a chosen percentage.

highlights.zh: 优化 Tick 回放、图表视野恢复、交易信号对齐与净风险仓位计算。
highlights.en: Improved Tick replay, chart-view restoration, trading-signal alignment, and net-risk position sizing.

highlights.zh: 修复指标空值与点状绘制、前导零手数输入及订单方向标签等问题。
highlights.en: Fixed indicator gaps and dot rendering, leading-zero lot entry, and order-side labels.
